about: The evangelium of the formulary “Annunciation of the Blessed Virgin Mary” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: At that time, the Angel Gabriel was sent by God into a city of Galilee whose name is Nazareth, to a virgin promised in marriage to a man whose name was Joseph, of David’s house; and the name of the virgin was Mary. And the angel, having come in to her, said: Hail, full of grace, the Lord is with you; blessed are you among women. Having heard this, she was troubled by his words, and she kept wondering what kind of greeting this was. And the angel said to her: Have no fear, Mary, for you have found grace with God. Behold, you will conceive in your womb and will bear a son, and you will call His name Jesus. He will be great, and He will be called the Son of the Most High, and the Lord God will give Him the throne of His father David; and He will reign in the house of Jacob forever, and there will be no end to His kingdom. Then Mary said to the angel: How will this be done, since I do not know man? And in answer the angel said to her: The Holy Spirit will come upon you, and the power of the Most High will overshadow you. And so the Holy One who will be born of you will also be called the Son of God. And behold, your kinswoman Elizabeth has also conceived a son in her old age, and this is the sixth month for her who is called barren; for no word will be impossible with God. Then Mary said: Behold the handmaid of the Lord; let it be done to me according to your word.
